question.text: Which committee's recommendations led to the revision of SEBI's venture capital regulations in 2000?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that SEBI's venture capital regulations were revised in 2000 following the recommendations of the K. B. Chandrasekhar Committee. The Trap: The Narasimham Committee dealt with banking-sector reforms, not venture capital. The other committees named are not the ones cited in the workbook for the 2000 VC revision. Note: Stay strictly with the workbook attribution — the K. B. Chandrasekhar Committee in 2000 — without overstating its scope or commenting on tax-regime changes that are not separately sourced here.
